build_SimpleConv_model: build a SimpleConv neural network model with configurable depth, kernel size, and channel dimensions
create_SimpleConv_with_STFT: create a SimpleConv model with STFT spectrogram transform for MEG signal processing

refactor_SimpleConv_subject_layers: refactor the SimpleConv model to enable subject-specific layers for multi-subject MEG data
